# Australia CGT Reform Calculator

This site is an interactive calculator and claim-check for Australia's capital gains tax reform debate.

Primary URL:
- Home: https://australia-cgt-reform-calculator.setiyaputra.me/
- Agent context JSON: https://australia-cgt-reform-calculator.setiyaputra.me/.well-known/ai-context.json

What the calculator does:
- compares current 50% CGT discount treatment
- compares an illustrative inflation-indexed alternative
- compares a full nominal-taxation reference case
- offers scenario presets and advanced assumptions for policy stress tests

Main scenario presets:
- Ambitious long hold
- Balanced wealth builder
- Moderate compounding path

Advanced scenario presets:
- Founder with Subdiv 152 relief
- Straddle-the-cutoff investor
- Property with NG offset

How to interpret it:
- It is a sensitivity tool, not tax or legal advice.
- The reform settings are illustrative unless a final legislative package is specified.
- The page also includes claim-check and evidence framing sections that are distinct from the raw calculator math.

Related resources:
- Claims monitor: https://factual-au.setiyaputra.me/
- Matrix viewer: https://budget-2026-cgt-negative-gearing-matrix.pages.dev/
- Source code: https://github.com/suryast/australia-cgt-reform
